openFindings.title: A hung leg blocks the battery forever
A nonzero probe exit is reported as printed no route decision
The detail cap truncates FAIL lines while the repair says each
Repair and diagnostic branches lack test cases
Caller-supplied --prompt is rendered into report lines unsanitized
Raw leg output is admitted into report lines without control-character filtering
Spec Files to Change omits three files the change modifies
Leg wiring invariants are implicit; a missing JUDGES entry crashes instead of reporting
Header comment calls every leg a child process; the provisioning leg resolves in-process
Legacy-stub repair crashes the battery when the guard module is unavailable
Probe passes on any hub's route decision; the served hubId is never checked
